question: Mayurbhanj Chhau dance is native to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mayurbhanj Chhau is a traditional dance form that originated in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha.
 
• It is one of the three forms of Chhau dance, the other two being Seraikella Chhau of Jharkhand and Purulia Chhau of West Bengal.
 
• This dance form is known for its vigorous martial movements and intricate footwork, which are inspired by the martial arts traditions of the region.
 
• Mayurbhanj Chhau is performed during various festivals and occasions, most notably during the Chaitra Parva festival, which is celebrated in the month of April.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau Dance:**

 
 
• Chhau is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk traditions, with origins in eastern India.
 
• It is performed in the states of Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal and is recognized as an intangible cultural heritage by UNESCO.
 
• The dance incorporates masks in the Seraikella and Purulia styles, while the Mayurbhanj style does not use masks.
 
• Chhau dance themes often revolve around mythological stories, epics like the Ramayana and Mahabharata, and local folklore.
 
 
 
• **Chaitra Parva:**
 
 
• Chaitra Parva is a significant festival in Odisha, celebrated in the month of Chaitra (March-April) according to the Hindu calendar.
 
• It marks the beginning of the new year for the tribal communities in the region and is celebrated with great enthusiasm.
 
• The festival is known for its vibrant cultural performances, including the Chhau dance, which is a major highlight.
 
• People from various communities come together to participate in the festivities, showcasing their rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Martial Arts Influence:**
 
 
• Mayurbhanj Chhau dance is heavily influenced by the martial arts traditions of the region, incorporating dynamic movements and acrobatics.
 
• Performers often undergo rigorous training to master the techniques and physical prowess required for the dance.
 
• The dance movements depict various aspects of martial arts, including combat techniques, weapon usage, and defensive stances.
 
• This influence adds a unique and energetic dimension to the Mayurbhanj Chhau dance, setting it apart from other dance forms.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO Recognition:**
 
 
• In 2010, Chhau dance was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO.
 
• This recognition highlights the cultural significance and unique heritage of the Chhau dance tradition.
 
• UNESCO's recognition helps in preserving and promoting the art form, ensuring its continuation for future generations.
 
• It also brings international attention to the rich cultural diversity and artistic expressions of India.
